tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bdag 'jug ngag 'don ye shes dwangs bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /gang sku'i dkyil 'khor yid la shar tsam gyis/
༄༅/ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bdag 'jug ngag 'don ye shes dwangs bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /gang sku'i dkyil 'khor yid la shar tsam gyis/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bdag 'jug ngag 'don ye shes dwangs bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so//

gang sku'i dkyil 'khor yid la shar tsam gyis/ /grub gnyis zil dngar bde blag stsol mdzad pa/ /bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lor gus btud na/ /dbang bzhi'i ye shes zab mos rgyud smin mdzod/ de'ang lam dus kyi dam tshig gso zhing ye shes spel ba la shin tu gal che zhing*/ sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs su'ang nye bar mkho ba bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga /yang zab dgongs pa'i gter kha rgya mtsho'i yang bcud 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum gyi dril sgrub sgrol dkar 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bdag 'jug mdor bsdus te blang ba'i tshul ni/ las byang gi gzhung bsrangs nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bzlas pa'i mjug tu dbang don du rnam bum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng : kha dog lnga ldan yi ge bh+rūm̐: yongs gyur phyi ni rin po che'i: rang bzhin bum pa bzang po che: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs 'od du 'bar: nang ni lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gnas: rin chen gzhal med khang chen por: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa yi: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rab 'byams kun: snang stong chu zla lta bur gsal: kun kyang spyi mgrin thugs ka ru: rdo rje gsum gyi yi ges mtshan: zhes sogs gnas gsum byin brlab nas bzung/ mchod bstod par las rim rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya/ de nas gzungs thag blangs la/ rang gi thugs nas sngags kyi phreng : rdo rje'i gzungs thag las brgyud de: bum lha'i thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: bde stong rol pa'i 'od zer sprin: mkha' khyab kun tu snang ba yis: 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i don kun bsgrubs: tshur 'dus thugs kyi dpal ber 'khyil: sku dang sngags las bdud rtsi'i rgyun: dpag med byung nas bum pa'i bcud: dngos grub kun gyi snying por gyur: ces gsal btab nas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi bzlas pa gtso 'khor gyi 'gros sbyar ba ci nus mthar dbyangs gsal rten snying*/

mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i mchod yon phul/ bum lha 'od zhu bdud rtsir gyur: las bum la dmigs te/ las bum nang du pad nyi'i steng : pad+ma rta mgrin sku mdog dmar: phyag gnyis pad+ma dril bu 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs dor stabs bzhugs: sku las rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur: oṃ hrīḥpad+man ta kṛ ta sarba bighān ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: ci rigs bzlas mthar kha rgyan gyis bum chu blangs te 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐: khro bo chen pos dbang gi bya ba ma grub bar bgegs thams cad zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces gsol bas zhal gyis bzhes te lha 'od du zhu ba las chu dbang drag gi nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ de nas tshe 'gugs sogs nas tshogs mchod bar dkyus ltar bya/ bdag 'jug dngos la/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la ha la hūm̐ zhes gu gul yungs kar rol mo'i tsham rngams dang bcas bgegs bskrad/ badz+ra dz+nyā na aḥhūm̐ gis srung 'khor gsal gdab/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥbhan+dha ba ra ma ṇa ya swā hā dang*/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis mig dar 'ching tshul dang me tog blang*/ hoḥ bde chen dgyes pa'i ye shes sku: rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol: thar pa mchog gi grong khyer du: slob dpon chen pos bdag gzhug gsol: lan gsum/ na mo: bdag sogs sogs dang*/ hoḥ mkha' mnyam sogs dang*/ hoḥ phyogs dus sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs sems tshogs bsag /pad+ma'i rigs mchog bla ma dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste: byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar: mtha' yas 'gro kun sgrol ba'i phyir: gzhan gnod gzhir bcas yongs su spang : gzhan phan byang chub sems mchog bskyed: gnyis ka mnyam pa chen po yi: thabs chen gsang ba sngags kyi srog: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi:

rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig dang : sdom pa ma lus yongs su gzung : tshul bzhin du ni bslab par bgyi: lan gsum gyis sdom gzung bya/ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na pra be sha ya phaṭa kyis sgo dbye/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa nang du gzhug oṃ na ma ste hūm̐: oṃ na mā mi hūm̐: oṃ na mo na ma hūm̐ gis phyag gsum bya/ hūm̐: 'thungs shig rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu: lce la bzhag kyang snying dkyil thim: ma bsrungs 'dod pa'i dngos grub nyams: bsrungs na ye shes tshe 'dir rnyed: sa ma ya a mṛta u da ka hūm̐ gis dam chu myang : ye shes dbab pa ni/ snod ni pad+ma bkod pa'i zhing : bcud kyi rtog pa 'phags ma'i sku: rang 'od yab dang mnyam sbyor ba'i: thugs srog tām̐ la sems bzung zhing : snyoms 'jug sgra dang 'od zer sprin: gdung ba'i glu yis thugs dam bskul: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya ni: char bzhin babs te dbyer med thim: ye shes chen po'i byin thob gyur: spos rol bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: a la la hoḥ sogs las byang ltar dbab/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag /oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha bhūm̐: gyis brtan/ oṃ rat+na puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hoḥ sa me tog dor zhing*/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la tiṣ+ṭha oṃ kyis 'ching*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa kyis mig dar bsal/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ dngos gzhi'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul/ hoḥ rigs rnams kun bdag slob dpon gyis: thugs rjes brtse bas nyer bzung nas: go 'phang mchog tu dbugs dbyung phyir: ye shes dbang bskur stsal du gsol: lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dbyer med pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs nas bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang bcas dgyes bzhin du dbang bskur bar gyur/ bum pa spyi bor blangs la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: dkyil 'khor rab 'byams thams cad kyi: ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan pa'i: bkra shis bum pas dbang bskur bas: sku dang ye shes yongs rdzogs shog: badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: su ra tā stāṃ a haṃ: sku gang sgrib dag nus pa bzhag: chu lhag gyen du 'khyil ba las: rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha rnams rang la thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā' sa me tog spyi bor bzhag cing brtan/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā' sa mchod/ shis brjod gang rig bya/ de ltar na bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'-i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o/ /gsang dbang ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo tha mi dad pa rang 'od kyi yab dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi thogs la/ āḥ dga' ba mchog gis drangs pa'i bcud: byang chub sems kyi dam tshig gis: rtsa khams rlung la dbang bskur bas: bsal stong zung 'jug nyams myong shog: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ bdud rtsi myang*/ de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lam nye bsnyen rtsa rlung gtum mo sgom pa la dbang/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o/ /sher dbang ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal gar gyi dbang phyug tu gsal ba la mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rigs dang lang tsho rdzogs pa'i rig ma 'chi med 'phags ma'i ngo bo can re spros te thar pa bsten par bskul bar gyur/ rig tsaka gam dril bu blangs la/ hūm̐: rnam pa kun ldan ye shes ni: rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med: 'du shes gsum gyis mnyam sbyor bas: dpe yi lhan skyes rtogs par shog:

oṃ karma mu drā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rang dang rig ma 'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi bde ba rgyud la skyes par gyur/ 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /lam sgrub pa pho nya'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o/ /dbang bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long 'ja' shel bzung la/ ho: dbyings ni rnam dag shel lta bu: rig pa ye shes 'ja' ltar shar: zung 'jug 'dus ma byas pa'i ngang : don gyi dgongs pa mngon gyur shog: oṃ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ho: zhes dpe'i brda thabs kyis mtshon te: āḥ lta ba blo 'das gdod ma'i babs: sgom pa ma bcos lhug par bzhag: spyod pa rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang : 'bras bu gzhi snang chen por rdzogs: a a a: zhes dgongs pa bskyang*/ de ltar na dbang bzhi pa thob/ bag chags kyi dri ma dag /lam sgrub pa chen po dbyings rig zung 'jug sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o/ rjes/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi ltar dang*/ tshogs rdzas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir brlabs shing rol pa dang lhag ma sogs bkra shis bar phrin las ltar mthar dbyung ngo*/ /'di'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su bzung na snga 'gyur spyi'i bzhed srol ltar don dbang gi smin byed du 'gyur bas mtshams sbyor ji ltar rigs pa dang bcas 'di kho na ltar bsgrubs pas chog cing*/ cung zad spro na bum dbang gi rjes/ nang nus pa 'jug pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i mthar maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab nas bzung thun mong tshe'i rjes gnang rgyas gdab dang bcas pa bgyis na skabs su bab cing legs par 'gyur la/ mthar bkra shis rdzas rtags sna bdun bcas sbyin pa dang*/

shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa'ang bya'o/ /lhag pa'i lha gang la brten kyang rim pa gnyis nyams su len pa'i cha rkyen lam dus kyi dbang len pa 'di nyid med du mi rung ba yin kyang snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa phyis byon phal mo che sla chos kho na'i dbang du song ba la snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma gter chen 'gyur med rdo rjes lam srol gsar du snang bar mdzad pa ltar 'dir yang shin tu gal po che'i gnad gsang ji bzhin gzigs nas zab gter 'di nyid kyi mnga' bdag gter chen bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas bkas gnang ba'i zhal lung gtsang ma yid brtan du rung ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i rdo rje'i ye shes bzhi'i/ /byin rlabs sgo gsum thig ler 'bad med zhugs/ /'chi med rtag brtan g.yung drung dpal brnyes te/ /srid zhi'i khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon gyur cig /ces pa'ang rje btsun bla ma gang gis gsang gsum ye shes snang bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhal med khang bkra shis 'chi med grub pa'i dga' tshal du blo gros mtha' yas kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// //
